```{r}
#| include: false
source(params$helpers)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
# source code, DOI and the date of the Zotero data
downloaded <- as.Date(do.call(c, lapply(params$metrics, function(f) readRDS(f)$downloaded)))
data_dates <- if (min(downloaded) == max(downloaded)) {
  format(min(downloaded), "%d %B %Y")
} else {
  paste(format(min(downloaded), "%d %B %Y"), "to", format(max(downloaded), "%d %B %Y"))
}
cat(
  if (nzchar(params$doi)) {
    paste0("[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/", params$doi, ".svg)](https://doi.org/", params$doi, ") ")
  },
  "IPBES Literature Report ", params$version,
  " · source code on [GitHub](", params$repository, '){target="_blank"}',
  " · Zotero data of ", data_dates, "\n\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

These reports show the state of the IPBES Zotero groups, and list the items
in each group which should be corrected. Open the report of a group for the
details and for links to the items in Zotero.

## Groups

```{r}
groups <- lapply(
  seq_along(params$metrics),
  function(i) {
    m <- readRDS(params$metrics[[i]])
    checks <- rep_checks(m)
    tibble::tibble(
      Group = paste0(
        "[", params$names[[i]], "](", params$reports[[i]], '){target="_blank"}'
      ),
      Items = nrow(m$items),
      `With DOI` = paste0(round(m$identifiers$met_id_doi$zotero$pc), "%"),
      `Please fix` = sum(checks$count[checks$status == "Please fix"]),
      `Please check` = sum(checks$count[checks$status == "Please check"]),
      `Zotero data of` = format(as.Date(m$downloaded), "%d %b %Y"),
      Zotero = paste0(
        "[open](https://www.zotero.org/groups/", params$ids[[i]],
        '){target="_blank"}'
      )
    )
  }
)

knitr::kable(
  dplyr::bind_rows(groups),
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l")
)
```

**Please fix**: number of items with errors. **Please check**: number of
items which may need a correction.

## Zotero plugins

The problems listed in the reports can be fixed directly in Zotero with two
plugins for Zotero 10. **Zotero Fix Proposals** shows the fixes proposed for
a group (Tools → Fix Proposals…), and **Zotero Safe Edit** checks every
change, asks you to approve it, writes it, logs it and lets you undo it.

```{r}
plugins <- jsonlite::read_json(params$plugins)
knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    Plugin = vapply(plugins, function(p) paste0("**", p$name, "**"), ""),
    Version = vapply(plugins, function(p) p$version, ""),
    Download = vapply(plugins, function(p) paste0("[download](", p$download, ")"), ""),
    `What it does` = vapply(plugins, function(p) p$description, ""),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
)
```

To install: download both files, then in Zotero: Tools → Plugins → gear
icon → *Install Plugin From File…*. Afterwards the plugins update
themselves. Before fixing anything:

1. In Settings → Safe Edit, allow the fields to be fixed (e.g. `DOI,
   language, date, publicationTitle, volume, issue, pages, extra, ISSN`).
2. Switch off automatic sync (Settings → Sync), and sync by hand when done.
3. Open Tools → Fix Proposals…, allow it to propose edits, make a backup of
   the group, and work through the fixes.

## Metrics documentation

The measures calculated for each group, and what they contain.

#| output: asis

docs <- docs[docs != "# Metrics"]
cat(sub("^(#+) ", "\\1# ", docs), sep = "\n")
